profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Bloomberg
profile.summary:
Software Engineer at Bloomberg, LP in DT Content Procurement and Classification, formerly DT Earnings Estimates, previously on FI/FX External Trading.

Graduated with a Master's Degree from Georgia Institute of Technology, studying Computer Science with a specialization in Machine Learning. Graduate coursework focused on mathematics and optimization. Research interests in machine learning for misinformation and financial technology. Former Graduate Research Assistant for GTRI Electro-Optical Systems Laboratory working in Machine Learning Visualization.

Completed undergrad at Georgia Institute of Technology, majoring in Electrical Engineering and minoring in Computer Science. Engineering coursework focused on embedded systems, control systems, and robotics. CS coursework focused on Intelligence. Research interests in microelectronics and signal processing. 

Won Best Overall Project - Interdisciplinary award at Georgia Tech Fall 2019 Capstone as a part of team Calibration Nation, with a project that focused on autonomous calibration of self-driving cars.

Worked as an undergraduate Teaching Assistant for ECE 4180 - Embedded Systems Design for two semesters. Conducted undergrad research in Large-scale Data Analysis of Power Grid Resilience under Dr. Chuanyi JI.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Skills: Python · Machine Learning · Data Engineering · Java · Natural Language Processing (NLP)

positions.title: Data Science Graduate Research Intern
positions.description:
Adaptive Stress Testing (AST) of ACAS sXu for AOS QNI Group
• Worked with NASA on Adaptive Stress Testing,  a reinforcement learner for testing ACAS algorithms written in Julia
• Decreased ACAS stress testing to 1000 iterations in 8 hours
• Analyzed and visualized performance of AST for determining potential deployment
• Improved AST speed by 25% by deploying lightweight version with large-scale cloud integration using clusters
• Presented work at AOSCon 2021
positions.insights: Skills: Deep Learning · Python · Machine Learning · TensorFlow

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Machine Learning Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Graduate researcher for Electro-Optical Systems Laboratory developing SUMMIT, a machine learning visualization tool.

positions.title: Machine Learning Research Intern
positions.description:
Electro-Optical Systems Laboratory under Dr. Samuel Shapero
• Developed, tested, and optimized Deep Neural Network for classification of Radio Frequency waveforms 
• Tuned deep neural network to improve classification accuracy by 25% on a 4 class, 14 emitter set of generated waveforms
• Used recurrent neural network to increase classification accuracy by 30% on a similar dataset with more difficult waveforms 
• Froze Keras model to run on NCS2 MYRIAD as a proof of concept

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant for ECE 4180 - Embedded Systems Design.

positions.title: Data Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Data Transformation - Retail and Direct Tech, Team Mt. Washington
•	Implemented Apache Airflow as a cloud-based platform to leverage AWS EMR clustering capability
•	Created multiple EMRs using CFT to install Airflow for Development and Production usage
•	Created Apache Spark Submit operations in Airflow DAGs using HDFS
•	Worked alongside Data Scientists in creating Proof of Concept DAG to submit PySpark jobs running Snowflake databases, S3 bucket, authentication processes, and multiple internal dependencies

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
Student Researcher in Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, performing large-scale data analysis of power grid resilience under Dr. Chuanyi Ji	          
• Detected power grid vulnerability during weather disruptions through big data analytics and machine learning
• Performed feature selection on datasets for machine learning algorithm to improve predictive capabilities

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Global Property Team
• Led a risk engineering project on creating a forecasting early warning detection tool/application to predict weather-based potential liabilities for insurance purposes.
• Led a project for creating a new back-end architecture for attritional loss database.
• Created an application for usage with attritional losses, allowing comparison/querying for SQL databases through a search functionality.
• Worked on a machine learning object detection model using a RetinaNet neural network by leveraging a Keras implementation to generate template code from sketches

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
Undergraduate research assistant in microelectronics, focusing on Integrated Circuits Wafer Fabrication.

• Attended wafer fabrication laboratory classes to learn how to properly utilize a cleanroom, as well as procedural instructions for IC Fabrication.
     • Instructions include skills such as patterning, photolithography, deposition, cleaning, masking, removal, and etch processes. 
• Created a new mask that incorporated improved designs such as Through-Silicon VIAs that allowed electrical connections on both sides of the wafer.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Communication and signals (C&S) intern in the Wayside Detector Group. 
• Observed and maintained 900+ Hot Bearing Detectors (HBD) across the east coast. 
• Responsibilities include daily observance and problem solving with HBD issues, as well as managing, contacting, and delegating information to maintainers in the broken HBD area. 
     • For closer issues, responsibilities extended to physically supervising and assisting work groups as they fixed or installed equipment.. 

Assisted with teaching a class on electrical maintenance and repair for detectors.

honors.title: Best Overall Project Interdisciplinary
honors.description: Award given to team Calibration Nation for having the Best Overall Project in the Interdisciplinary category at Georgia Tech Fall 2019 Capstone.
honors.issuer: Issued by Georgia Institute of Technology · Dec 2019

projects.title: Calibration Nation
projects.description:
Georgia Tech Senior Design - GT 4823 Capstone Project

Project sponsored by Cox Automotive

•	Modified and automated Autel Maxisys Calibration Frame for Advanced Driver Assistance Systems using embedded systems and sensors to reduce setup time and improved efficiency by 75%
•	Added mBed LPC1768 microcontrollers and LIDAR sensors to replace antiquated measuring tapes
•	Dismantled and reverse-engineered control systems to add microcontroller communication
•	Collaborated with sponsors Cox Automotive to ensure functional usage with vehicle technicians
•	Won Best Overall Interdisciplinary Project at Georgia Tech Fall 2019 Capstone
